field_justifications.authority_context_origin: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: echoed from the recorded request, so it is a pure function of the request bytes
field_justifications.bootstrap_defence_in_depth_verification: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: the worker's restatement of the bootstrap binding; drift of any bootstrap source changes it
field_justifications.bytecode_cache_binding: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: the preserved Repair A verdict; a cache namespace that is not fresh and empty changes it
field_justifications.calendar_authority_sha256: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: authority-bound, compared against the frozen trusted context before execution and again after
field_justifications.decision_time: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: echoed from the recorded request; it is the decision time the request names, never a clock read at run time
field_justifications.evidence_admission_mode: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: echoed from the recorded request
field_justifications.failure_reason: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: the worker's own verdict; a refusal that re-derives as a success, or the reverse, must not compare equal
field_justifications.interpreter_flags: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: fixed by the frozen launch contract, so a changed launch flag is a rejection rather than a silent difference
field_justifications.interpreter_identity: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: authority-bound; this is the field that makes an interpreter-identity mismatch a rejection
field_justifications.loaded_project_modules: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: the count of certified project modules the worker actually imported; source drift changes it
field_justifications.operation: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: echoed from the recorded request
field_justifications.post_execution_source_verification: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: the preserved post-execution source verdict
field_justifications.project_source_manifest_digest: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: authority-bound; certified worker source drift changes it
field_justifications.request_digest: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: the digest of the exact canonical request bytes the worker received, so it is a pure function of those bytes
field_justifications.request_schema_version: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: echoed from the recorded request
field_justifications.result: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: the full scientific result. The projection carries the whole result object, not a summary of it
field_justifications.result_digest: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: the digest the worker bound to its result
field_justifications.status: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: the worker's SUCCESS or REFUSED verdict
field_justifications.sys_path_digest: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: a digest of the recorded request's sys_path, so it is a pure function of the request bytes
field_justifications.third_party_authority_digest: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: authority-bound frozen reviewed registry digest
field_justifications.third_party_installed_content_verificati: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: the preserved Repair D verdict
field_justifications.third_party_observed_content_manifest_di: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: measured from the installed third-party content. It is environment-derived, which is exactly why it is projected: installed-content drift then rejects instead of passing
field_justifications.worker_authority_ticket: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: authority-bound frozen worker protocol ticket
field_justifications.worker_bootstrap_manifest_digest: IN_PROJECTION_AUTHORITY: authority-bound; any bootstrap source drift changes it
